app.name: Medvya
consent.script: With your permission, Medvya will record our conversation today to help me write your medical notes. Only your care team can access it. You can say no or ask me to stop at any time, and your care will not change.
consent.declined: No recording for this visit. You can write the note manually.
msg.delivered: Delivered — this does not complete the task
ai.unavailable: AI drafting is unavailable right now. Your recording is saved.
err.403: You don’t have access to this facility.
push.generic: New update from {clinic}. Open Medvya to view.
state.sessionExpired.title: Session expired
state.sessionExpired.body: Your unsaved draft is kept on this device. Sign in again to continue; you will be asked to confirm the patient.
state.noAccess.body: You are signed in to {facility}. This record belongs to another facility.
state.notFound.title: Page not found
state.notFound.body: The link may be old. Nothing has been changed.
state.offline.title: You are offline
state.offline.body: Recording continues to the encrypted device buffer. Notes and orders will save when you reconnect.
session.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again, or ask your clinic admin if it keeps happening.
shell.comingInPhase: This screen arrives in phase {phase}. There is nothing to do here yet.
shell.noScreens.title: Nothing to show yet
shell.noScreens.body: No screens are switched on for your role at this facility. Ask your practice admin if you expected access.
shell.chooseFacility.title: Choose where you are working today
shell.chooseFacility.body: Signed in as {name}. No facility is selected yet. Choosing a facility is being added; until then, ask your practice admin if you need access.
site.nav.label: Main
site.region.label: Region
site.hero.tag.AE: Built for UAE clinics · DoH / DHA aware
site.hero.title: Talk to your patient. Medvya writes the note. You approve it.
site.hero.lede: A 60-second brief before every visit, consent-first ambient notes in {languages}, and accountable follow-ups. Appointments and billing included for independent doctors.
site.residency.IN: Data stays in India · Azure Central India
site.residency.AE: Data stays in the UAE · Azure UAE North
site.cta.doctor: I'm a doctor · start free trial
site.pillar.brief.title: Know the patient in 60 seconds
site.pillar.brief.body: Verified history and an AI summary, clearly separated.
site.pillar.consent.title: Consent before every recording
site.pillar.consent.body: Patients can say no; manual notes always work.
site.pillar.followUp.title: Nothing falls through
site.pillar.followUp.body: Results and follow-ups tracked until someone closes them.
site.pricing.title: Pricing
site.pricing.body: Prices are not published yet. Start a free trial as a doctor, or book a demo for your hospital.
schedule.error.title: The schedule could not be loaded
schedule.error.body: Nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
schedule.forbidden.body: Ask your practice admin for access to this facility's schedule.
schedule.empty.title: No doctors or resources here yet
schedule.empty.body: Add a doctor, or a resource such as a procedure room, in Practice settings to see their calendar.
site.trust.title: How Medvya handles patient data
site.trust.residency.title: Data residency
site.trust.residency.body: India and UAE run as separate deployments with separate keys, logs and backups.
site.trust.consent.title: Consent model
site.trust.consent.body: Treatment, recording, sharing, reminders and marketing are separate choices.
site.trust.ai.title: AI drafts
site.trust.ai.body: AI output is a draft until a licensed clinician reviews and signs it.
site.trust.retention.title: Retention
site.trust.retention.body: Audio kept 30 days by default; records per local medical rules.
site.trust.audit.title: Audit
site.trust.audit.body: Every access to a chart is logged and reviewable.
site.trust.subProcessors.title: Sub-processors
site.trust.subProcessors.body: Listed with region and purpose; changes announced 30 days ahead.
site.trust.footer: We describe our controls; we do not claim certifications we have not obtained. Policy versions and sub-processors are listed with dates.
site.trust.policies.title: Policy versions
site.demo.title: Book a demo
site.demo.intro: Tell us who you are and how to reach you.
site.form.noPatientData: Do not include patient information. This form is only for your own contact details.
site.form.name: Your name
site.form.contactHint: Give an email address, a phone number or both.
site.demo.sent: Thank you. We have received your request.
site.form.error.Name: Enter your name.
site.form.error.Contact: Enter an email address or a phone number.
site.form.error.Phone: Enter a valid phone number: digits, spaces and an optional +.
site.form.error.rateLimited: Too many requests from your network. Please try again later.
site.form.error.expired: This form has expired or was sent too quickly. Please send it again.
site.region.title: Where do you practise?
site.region.body: Your patients' data is stored and processed in this country. It cannot be moved to the other region later without a new account and export.
site.region.card.IN: Azure Central India · DPDP Act · ABDM integration available
site.region.card.AE: Azure UAE North · separate deployment · DoH / DHA / MOHAP integrations per emirate
